scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs with n at least 4. The structural reduction is proved directly; all-order constructions invoke the classical maximum-packing theorem for Mendelsohn triples. Finite computation is only a stress test. The accessible design-theory supplement reproduces and attributes the packing theorem to Gardner's 1997 paper; the original 1997 full text was not retrieved in this review.
title: Exact \(B\)-coloring number of crown graphs via Mendelsohn packings
